newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Smurfit, Forbairt create venture capital fund.
newsitem.headline: Smurfit, Forbairt create venture capital fund.

text.p: Irish paper and packaging firm Jefferson Smurfit and industrial development agency Forbairt have set up in a 10 million Irish pound venture capital fund.

Announcing the venture, Irish enterprise and employment minister Richard Bruton said the fund was designed "to provide long-term permanent finance that companies cannot provide themselves and that is crucial to their long-term growth".
The fund, which will be managed by new company Smurfit Venture Investments Limited, will make three million Irish pounds in funding immediately available.

Companies wishing to apply for funding must have plans to generate at least ten new jobs within three years, and the anticipated investment level is expected to range from 100,000 to 500,000 Irish pounds, a statement said.
